deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics. It is a pencil draft (or copy) of a private letter from Bernhard Riemann to his brother Wilhelm, written on a sheet that otherwise carries mathematical notes.

Content of the letter, paraphrased:
- He has not yet found a present, apparently for a sister or family member on some occasion. The words around 'Geschenk für ... wegen des ...' are not securely legible.
- He asks Wilhelm to send him cigars, if Wilhelm can and is willing.
- He asks Wilhelm to write and say whether he can. Otherwise Riemann would take them 'auf Rechnung' (on credit). He must settle this debt before his departure.
- Closing: 'Lebewohl, Lieber W. Dein treuer Bernhard.'
- Several struck-through false starts appear in lines 3-4, plus an insertion mark above the line.

Below the signature are two lines in another register. They read: 'Ich habe es als meine [Aufgabe?] ... in möglichst einfachen Beispielen die ... Methoden ...', with a struck word at the start of the second line and another struck word before 'Methoden'. This looks like the opening of a lecture introduction: an intention to present methods by means of the simplest possible examples. It is consistent with the surrounding lecture material. The previous page holds potential-theory lecture notes (Poisson equation, boundary-value problem). The next page holds the product expansion φ(z)=∏_{n≥0}(1−zq^{2n})∏_{n≥1}(1−q^{2n}/z) and its Laurent series, i.e. the Jacobi triple product.

The mark '79' in the upper right is the folio number.

No derivation, formula or computation is present to reconstruct.

transcription_corrections: The signature line reads 'Lebewohl, Lieber W.' and the closing 'Dein treuer Bernhard.' The machine reading is broadly right.

Line 1, 'Ein Geschenk für [?] [?] wegen des [?]': the word after 'für' looks like 'Schwester(n)'. The word after 'wegen des' may be 'Geburtstags' or similar. This is uncertain; superscript corrections stand above it.

The interlinear marks above the struck passage in line 3 (a small insertion sign with 'f' or 'b') indicate the inserted 'Bitte'. The many struck words ('Bitte schicke ...', 'Lust', 'Ich ... ') are cancelled false starts and are correctly marked as deletions.

Bottom lines: 'Ich habe es als meine' is followed by an illegible word, possibly 'Aufgabe' (missing in the image line). The second line begins with a struck word and reads '... in möglichst einfachen Beispielen die [struck] Methoden'.
The '79' at the right margin is the folio number, not part of the text.
